verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs name official first-party Python and JavaScript/TypeScript libraries for building applications, backed by its own REST API, so the product itself provides SDKs. However, the evidence is only one-line mentions with no SDK reference depth or hands-on corroboration, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404, so the extent of SDK coverage is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed SDK reference documentation (methods, streaming, tool-calling coverage), SDKs beyond Python/JS, a published machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
